name: Question 19
problem:
Consider the following matrices:

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3}+2 & \,\,-2 \\ 2 & \,\,\sqrt{3}-2\end{aligned}],\,\,\,J=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3} & \,1 \\ 0 & \,\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}],\,\,\,P=[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Given that $G=PJ{P}^{-1},$ find $12\operatorname{arctan}⁡G.$
